preamble.summary: 1 Samuel 28 narrates Saul's consultation of the medium at Endor and the appearance of Samuel. 4QSamᵃ preserves portions of this theologically dense chapter with minor variants.
preamble.notable_variants: Minor wording variants. The substance of the necromancy narrative — including Samuel's appearance from below the earth and his prophecy of Saul's death — tracks MT.

variant_notes: The medium's description of Samuel as 'a god (elohim) coming up out of the earth' tracks MT — a striking use of elohim for a deceased prophet.
